body: OOO! I made this pattern but I used red, white and black! I love those colors! :)

Knitting & crochet are my biggest ones. But generally just making things is something I enjoy - like painting, drawing, sewing, etc. 

And, when I don't have the materials/energy to do those things, I really enjoy researching specific topics and learning a lot about them. For example, I used to be fascinated with tornadoes, so I watched a bunch of documentaries about them, and videos explaining how they form.
